 Alabama coastal favorite isn’t fine dining, but ‘the finest of casual dining’
 Sunday 10 AM – 9 PM • Monday–Wednesday 11 AM – 10 PM • Thursday–Saturday 11 AM – 10 PM
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 Welcome to Tin Top

 
 
 
 Bon Secour’s coastal kitchen since 2004.
 

 
 Welcome to Tin Top Restaurant & Oyster Bar—our coastal kitchen along the Bon Secour River. Since 2004, we’ve kept the focus simple: start with exceptional ingredients, treat them with respect, and serve every guest with genuine Southern hospitality.
 

 From the Gulf, To Your Table!
 
 You’ll taste it in the briny snap of freshly shucked oysters, the sweetness of Royal Reds, and the smoke-kissed edges of a grilled Gulf catch. Hand-cut steaks get a deep, sizzling sear and a clean finish—no shortcuts, just technique and time.
 
 
 Lunch keeps things light and lively; dinner settles into a warm, relaxed rhythm. Sundays bring a brunch built for lingering, while weekly and Happy Hour specials keep the board fresh with seasonal finds and chef favorites.
 
 
 We pour with the same care we cook—easy-going beers, a thoughtful wine list, and cocktails that pair cleanly with the food. Save room for a sweet finish (locals swear by the white chocolate pudding).
 
 
 Whether you’re dropping in after a day on the coast or planning a celebration, we’re here to make your time with us memorable—plate after plate, visit after visit. Thanks for being here; we look forward to serving you.

 WHO WE ARE
 Bob Hallmark didn't always know he would be in the restaurant business. Before opening up this popular dining destination in 2004, Bob was a general contractor. Today we are proud to serve seafood and other favorite area side dishes to local friends and out-of-town guests alike. 
 

 
 
 OUR BEGINNINGS
 Growing up with four brothers and a mom with a passion for cooking, opening up a restaurant to showcase his love for food was a dream for Bob Hallmark. After years of entertaining family and friends and preparing amazing spreads of a variety of foods, fulfilling that dream soon became a reality. Right in the heart of Bon Secour, the Tin Top is a great place for steak and all your Coastal Alabama favorites. 
 

 
 
 GIFT CARDS
Give the gift of Tin Top! Gift cards are available in any amount and can be used for dine-in or takeout. 
Pick one up in our gift shop, or call us to purchase and have it mailed to you.

 The Pearl of Bon Secour
 About Tin Top Restaurant
 Since 2004, we’ve kept it coastal and classic—fresh Gulf seafood, hand-cut steaks, and warm service along the Bon Secour River. 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our Story
 Tucked beside the Bon Secour River, Tin Top has welcomed locals and travelers since 2004—serving fresh, local fare with a New Orleans, southern coastal twist. 
 
 
 Our Beginnings
 Before opening Tin Top, Bob was a contractor. His passion for hosting turned into a kitchen that feels like home. 
 
 
 Our Mission
 Keep it simple. Cook it right. Serve the best ingredients with warmth and consistency—every plate, every time. 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 The Old Tin Top Restaurant & Oyster Bar

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
About Tin Top Restaurant

Tin Top Restaurant is a coastal kitchen built on simple ideas: fresh ingredients, honest cooking, and the kind of hospitality that makes you feel like a regular on your first visit. Our menu leans into Gulf flavors—think crisp oysters, local seafood when available, and Southern staples done right—balanced with hand-cut steaks, hearty salads, and seasonal sides. Whether you’re gathering with friends on a weeknight or celebrating a milestone, we keep the table plentiful and the service warm.
 

 We start with quality and let the details do the talking. Seafood is handled with care and cooked to highlight texture and sweetness; steaks are seasoned, seared, and rested for a clean finish; sauces are built in-house for depth without heaviness. We plate generously and aim for balance—bright acidity against rich butter, a little crunch where a dish needs lift, and a finish that invites one more bite. The bar follows the same approach: classic cocktails, easy-drinking wines, and a cold beer list designed for the coast.
 

 Tin Top is a place to relax—unhurried meals, easy conversation, and staff who remember your favorites. From date nights and family dinners to out-of-town guests, we’re proud to be part of your Baldwin County traditions. Come for the oysters or the steak; stay for the company and the feeling that you’re exactly where you should be.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 New & Improved
 Still Tin Top—Just Better
 Coastal classics, polished service, same warm welcome.
 
 We’ve refreshed a few favorites, added seasonal plates, and tightened our timing—keeping the Gulf flavors you love while making every visit smoother. From crisp oysters and hand-cut steaks to easy-drinking cocktails, it’s the Tin Top you know—tuned up and ready when you are.
